tagline: Google reviews for cafés, restaurants, salons & gyms
headline: More Google reviews. More customers walking in.
subline: One scan opens your Google review page. We make it easy for every happy customer to review you, track your reviews every month and help you show up higher on Google Maps.

services.title: Your review QR code
services.text: On tables, the counter and bills: one scan opens your Google review page.

services.title: Pay & review in one scan
services.text: One QR: customers pay by UPI and leave a review, all in one place.

services.title: Print-ready designs
services.text: Table tents, counter cards and window stickers with your name.

services.title: Review requests on WhatsApp
services.text: Your customer list gets a friendly thank-you with your review link.

services.title: Monthly review report
services.text: New reviews and your star rating, month by month.

services.title: What Google brings you
services.text: Calls, directions and website visits from your Google profile.

services.title: See it with your name on it, free.
services.text: Reply “yes” and we send you a free preview: your own QR design with your business's name, ready to print. No cost, no obligation.
